segments.text: proposition 1 AN oth is a confirmation of the will of God or a teſtimonie of diuine things.
proposition 2 An oth of his owne nature is good.
proposition 3 It is lawfull for a chriſtian man to ſweare.
proposition 4 Although that an oth ariſe of an ill occaſion, yet is it of a good cauſe.
proposition 5 An oth, whereby thoſe things are confirmed which be repugnant with the word of God, is void.
proposition 6 To auoid periurie, it is good not to ſweare but ſeldome, and for great cauſes.
proposition 7 We muſt not ſweare by the names of idols.
